text:
Alex (CSM): Quick heads-up — BlueMesa Logistics (org_bm_789) just told me their product org added 4 squads this week and started using the embeddings + rerank routes. They reported a ~3x increase in QPS and are seeing tail latency spikes. Can infra/provisioning check capacity and possible short-term burst?

Maria (AM): Noted. Renewal for BlueMesa is in ~6 months, looks like a strong expansion signal if we can keep perf stable. I'll loop in AE for upsell motion. Can we get a quick triage and a playbook for onboarding the new squads? :eyes:

Sam (Infra): On it. Can you paste recent traffic numbers or a dashboard link? We can do a 48h burst (2 dedicated pods) and enable prefix caching to blunt the token cost. Need org id and sample request patterns (seq len, embedding size).

Alex (CSM): Pasting sample from their telemetry — QPS: 120 -> 360 over 08:00-12:00 UTC, median latencies jump 40% on embeddings. Org id: org_bm_789. Example endpoint: POST /v1/embeddings (batch size 8). Customer said they ramped nightly ingest and new interactive squads are hitting realtime summarize.

Jae (Support): I'll schedule an enablement + ops runbook session for tomorrow 11:00am PT with their infra and PMs. We should capture any prompt engineering or batching gaps. I created a ticket: CS-9876 and added checklist (playbook link) — https://redwood.internal/playbooks/customer-onboard. Please add any specific logs/snippets to the ticket. :spiral_note_pad:

Sam (Infra): Thanks — I'll run `rb prov estimate --org org_bm_789 --window 24h` and post results. If we approve burst I'll run:

```
rb reserve --org org_bm_789 --pods 2 --profile dedicated-medium --duration 48h
```

We should also enable per-route KV caching for summarization.

infra-bot: Alert: usage anomaly detected for org_bm_789 — 2.9x baseline over 4h. Suggested actions: open temporary reservation, enable prefix cache, consider quantized model profile for embeddings.

Maria (AM): Looping in Matt (AE) — @Matt can you prep renewal/expansion convo? If we can commit to predictable latency and a short pilot of Dedicated, we can propose a 6–12 month reserved package. Also flag any compliance needs from BlueMesa (they handle PII in some docs).

Alex (CSM): I'll capture customer feedback during the enablement session and add notes to the renewal tracker. Also asking product for a suggested batching config for their 50–200 token summaries.

Sam (Infra): Prov estimate done — 48h burst would keep p95 < target if we provision 2 pods and enable caching. Posting numbers to CS-9876. I'll queue the reservation once Alex confirms.

Jae (Support): Added a post-call template to the ticket to capture: onboarding blockers, prompt patterns, misrouted requests, and any security/KMS asks. Recommend a short follow-up in 2 weeks to validate stability. :thumbsup:

Maria (AM): Great. Next steps: 1) Sam to provision burst after Alex confirms, 2) Jae to run enablement call tomorrow 11:00am PT, 3) Alex to capture feedback + add upsell notes to renewal tracker, 4) Matt (AE) to prep expansion proposal. Everyone ok?

Alex (CSM): ✅ I'll confirm reservation by EOD and post call notes after the enablement. Thanks team!
